cuba-libre.d: Black Tears’ own spec for the Havana classic. The lime is what makes it a Cuba Libre.
cuba-libre.m: Fill a highball with fresh cubed ice. Add the rum and lime, top slowly with cold cola and give it one or two gentle lifts with a bar spoon. Lime wedge.

havana-espresso.d: An Espresso Martini that finally tastes like rum.
havana-espresso.m: Shake hard with cubed ice. Double strain into a chilled coupe. Three coffee beans.

smoked-manhattan.d: The Manhattan, served in a hickory-smoked glass.
smoked-manhattan.m: Smoke a chilled coupe with hickory. Stir the rest 30 turns over ice and strain into the smoked glass. Brandied cherry.

burnt-ends-highball.d: Whiskey and premium soda with a charred lemon peel.
burnt-ends-highball.m: Build over cubes in a highball glass.

smoke-signal.d: A sour twist that lets the char run through.
smoke-signal.m: Dry shake. Shake again with ice. Double strain into a coupe.

tommys-margarita.d: The bartender’s margarita. Pueblo Viejo Blanco built right.
tommys-margarita.m: Shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass. Optional salt half-rim.

san-matias-old-fashioned.d: Gran Reserva, stirred with agave and mole bitters.
san-matias-old-fashioned.m: Stir down over ice. Strain into a rocks glass.

pisco-sour.d: Peru’s national cocktail, built on the Acholado.
pisco-sour.m: Shake hard over ice for the foam. Strain into a coupe and finish with a few drops of Angostura.

chilcano.d: Pisco and ginger ale: the easy, quick-build highball.
chilcano.m: Build over ice in a highball glass. Top slowly with ginger ale and stir once. Lime wheel.

caipirinha.d: Brazil’s national cocktail, made with fresh-cane cachaça.
caipirinha.m: Muddle the lime with the sugar in a rocks glass. Add Thoquino and crushed ice and build.

batida-de-coco.d: Cachaça shaken with coconut and condensed milk.
batida-de-coco.m: Blend, or shake hard. Serve in a rocks glass.

paloma.d: The Reposado paloma: grapefruit, lime and a pinch of salt.
paloma.m: Build over ice in a highball glass. Top with soda.

mango-smoothie.d: Thick, sunny and alcohol-free: Giffard Fruit for Mix Mango blended with yoghurt and milk.
mango-smoothie.m: Add everything to a blender and blend until smooth. Pour into a chilled highball and garnish with a slice of fresh mango.
